meta.name: IPIP-NEO-120 reconstruction shell for the Alan Turing persona
meta.instrument: International Personality Item Pool NEO (IPIP-NEO-120), item/facet structure per John A. Johnson (2014), 'Measuring thirty facets of the five factor model with a 120-item public-domain inventory', Journal of Research in Personality.
meta.disclaimer: This is a historical reconstruction exercise, not a claim that Alan Turing took the IPIP-NEO-120 or any personality inventory.
meta.status: item text and keying populated (Phase 2); responses not yet scored
meta.item_text_provenance: Item text and keying (+/-) transcribed from source S014 (the official IPIP item repository) and spot-checked for exact wording against three items independently quoted in source S015 (Kajonius & Johnson, 2019, Table 1) -- 'Love to read challenging material' (O5), 'Work hard' (C4), and 'Worry about things' (N1) all matched exactly.
meta.why_no_scores_yet: Populating item_text is a mechanical transcription task with a verifiable right answer. Scoring (proposed_response/evidence_type/confidence/rationale) is a different, higher-stakes kind of work -- it is deferred to a later, separate pass and even then will only be done conservatively, for items the evidence genuinely supports, not for all 120 simply because the instrument has 120 items.

items.item_text: Like to get lost in thought.
Believe in the importance of art.
See beauty in things that others might not notice.
Do not enjoy going to art museums.
Don't understand people who get emotional.
Prefer to stick with things that I know.
Am not interested in theoretical discussions.
Tend to vote for liberal political candidates.
Believe that there is no absolute right and wrong.
Tend to vote for conservative political candidates.
Believe that we should be tough on crime.
Know how to get things done.
Often forget to put things back in their proper place.
Leave a mess in my room.
Do more than what's expected of me.
Put little time and effort into my work.
Do just enough work to get by.
Talk to a lot of different people at parties.
Wait for others to lead the way.
Do a lot in my spare time.
Look at the bright side of life.
Believe that others have good intentions.
Use others for my own ends.
Am indifferent to the feelings of others.
Believe that I am better than others.
Have a high opinion of myself.
Feel sympathy for those who are worse off than myself.
Am not interested in other people's problems.
Try not to think about the needy.
Am often down in the dumps.
Find it difficult to approach others.
Am afraid to draw attention to myself.
Am not bothered by difficult social situations.
Am able to control my cravings.
Feel that I'm unable to deal with things.
